items.claim: Maersk meddelte at have gennemfoert den foerste kommercielle ship-to-ship-bunkring med ethanol af et deep-sea containerskib i USA, og Ditlev Blicher, Regional President for North America, sagde: "Achieving lower-emission logistics requires turning new technologies into practical, scalable solutions."
items.source: Ditlev Blicher, Maersk Regional President North America, i Maersks egen meddelelse

items.claim: Maersk meddelte en udvidelse af samarbejdet med PUMA, hvor Maersk overtager driften af PUMAs nordamerikanske distributionsnetvaerk, og Dave Hune, North America Head of Maersk Contract Logistics, sagde: "This partnership is a great example of how Maersk can combine our operational expertise, technology, and logistics network with a customer's existing assets to improve efficiency."
items.source: Dave Hune, North America Head of Maersk Contract Logistics, i Maersks egen meddelelse (PUMAs Helmut Leibbrandt citeres ligeledes)

items.claim: A.P. Moller - Maersk A/S reported its share buy-back transactions for the period 28 September to 2 October 2026 and restated that the second phase of the programme runs from 13 August 2026 up to and including 29 January 2027.
items.source: A.P. Moller - Maersk A/S company announcement, Copenhagen; contacts given as Martin Dunwoodie, Head of Investor Relations, and Jesper Lov, Head of Media Relations

items.claim: Maersk said it would introduce and revise its Peak Season Surcharge on container shipments from the East Coast of South America to several European markets, with effect from a Price Calculation Date of 1 November 2026.
items.source: Maersk customer advisory, as reported by Container News

items.claim: Maersk announced adjustments to its Peak Season Surcharges on three trades - China/Hong Kong to Kenya from 19 October 2026, Asia to Oceania from 1 November 2026, and Indian Subcontinent/Middle East to North America from 2 October 2026 - and said of the Kenya route that the surcharge will remain in effect until further notice and applies to non-SPOT bookings based on the Price Calculation Date.
items.source: Maersk customer advisories, as reported by Container News
